column1: # KenshiFP standing pose/presentation rules -> lab checks (spec-first). Read by Kenshi-Automation-Harness tools/animlab/spec.py
# (map / run / unarmed) and taste.py. Columns: id class rule source owner checks status note.
# owner: shay = Shay said it (memory / plan row "Problem (Shay)" / his review); coord = coordinator review verdict; inferred =
# nobody confirmed it yet (question for Shay, batched via the coordinator; never treated as his rule).
# status: covered = an automatic check gates it; partial = gated only in part (see note); missing = no check; out-of-reach = no
# check possible with the data we record (note says why).

column3: rule
column8: note

column3: edge lines up at the stroke start and leads through the stroke (wind-up may be off)
column8: stroke frames u .28-.58 only

column3: blade roughly in line with the forearm; shoulder/elbow drive the arc, wrist little
no hand/forearm roll in the wind-up; no sudden wrist/blade roll
no arm churn: elbow/forearm must not swing out and back while the weapon barely moves
column8: sword recordings; unarmed U9

column3: same swing input -> same forearm roll (no forearm flip mid-stroke)
column8: needs >= 3 swings from ready

column3: ready pose stable: no sudden ~90 deg roll mid-walk, one ready branch
column8: --ref a known-good recording of the same build

column3: sharp edge never faces the camera at rest (ready/walk/block)
column8: new (spec.py restedge, p05 of edge cos >= 0)

column3: wrist bend: holds <= 30 deg (PT30), swings <= 50 (Shay accepted wb36); solver-posed frames only, native-animation frames exempt (Shay 2026-10-10)
column4: PT17-W, PT30, X3, X5, c6a1eda, Shay 2026-10-10
column8: vmcheck.wrist gates swings at 30 too (FAILs Shay-accepted f28); spec.py wrist splits holds/swings, skips native frames (metrics.NATIVE_STATES)

column3: every state visibly plays: pose moves vs ready (aim, block, reload, swing)
column8: unarmed U3

column3: stock low (<= 25% from the bottom in ready), crossbow orientation unchanged
column8: --ref f14-xb0 (d40b6ad-era orientation)

column3: bolt and strings rigid on the crossbow
column8: needs the .bolt sidecar

column3: no shake in still poses (aim)
column8: new absolute check (aim jit_p95 <= 1.5 px), calibrated on 3 recordings; the replay-relative `compare` jitter line needs a build-matched solver

column3: no clipped or hollow limbs (near-plane cut)
column8: vmcheck (fp-viewmodel.sh) on the zoom-0 frames; unarmed U7

column3: zoom 25 looks natural: hand away from the head, weapon visible, wrist limit
column8: vmcheck zo only (PT29); `animlab.py` has no zoom-25 judgement (Misses X7 row OPEN); no Shay-labelled z25 recording

column3: every frame judgeable: open ground, nothing solid in frame, full res, no cursor
column8: videos (frames.py)

column3: review before handing over: every frame reviewed, flaws fixed first
column8: process rule (coordinator), not a property of a recording

column3: blade reads on screen: no one-frame snap at the wind-up top, never end-on, full length, overhead descends vertically
column8: stroke 0 = documented baseline exception (Shay-approved stroke fails snap/seen)

column3: block guard not hanging (blade not straight down, hilt not at the face)
column8: whether the native hanging guard is acceptable is Shay's call (open)

column3: zoom crossfade band: no own headless torso / floating hand between eye and head-show distance
column8: no game recording of the fail case yet

column3: take labels match game state; no combat / bystanders; video ends at the end label
column8: takes only

column3: hand grips the hilt (no open palm, fingers wrapped)
column8: recordings hold no finger bones; the visual lab renders fingers in the bind pose

column3: do not enlarge the arm / change framing to match Chivalry; only the movement matters
column8: a negative design rule: nothing to measure (framing changes show up as stock/stroke regressions)

column3: guard: both fists on screen at rest (zoom 0)
every technique returns to the guard
the technique visibly plays (fist moves >= 1 dm from the guard)
a punch drives toward the screen centre
no hand at / above / behind the eye (forearm/fist >= 2.5 dm from the eye, <= eye level +0.5 dm)
column4: PT29 hands at the head (Shay), NA1 row
column8: thresholds 2.5 / +0.5 dm are the lab's (native.py fists)

column3: wind-up stays below eye level
no near-plane cut of forearm/fist
wrist bend <= 30 deg
no arm churn
column8: same limits as the sword churn (450 px within 0.4 s, fist <= 250 px)

column3: punch driven by shoulder/elbow, not the wrist (wrist share of fist motion <= 0.6)
no sudden fist roll (<= 30 deg per 33 ms)
column4: sword roll rules (Shay) carried over; threshold inferred

column3: the game's half-open hand is accepted: no fist-closed check (skeletons have no finger bones)
column8: decision, nothing to gate; replaces the inferred "fist closed" rule

column3: zoom 25 = the native third-person animation, unchanged
column8: only after an in-game build (game recording + VMQUICK sheet); offline: native.py sheet-z25

column3: kicks / headbutt / flykick: guard holds, the camera reads the move
column8: no kick candidate format yet (camera motion is not in pose.txt)

column3: solver reaches every key (no IK failure)
block raises the guard
column8: no block candidate yet

column3: palm-heel techniques become straight-wrist punches (wrist <= 30 deg); native palm strikes are not kept
column8: spec.py unarmed: candidates named shotei*/palm* get U17 (wb_max <= 30 every frame)
